title: 第29章：条件
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“你说的是真的？”

    “大家别听他瞎咧咧，5分钱一斤，马家小子你有那么钱吗？别到时候大家把野菜拿来了，你却没钱付账。”

    说这话的不是别人正是江彩霞。

    本来她计划的一场逼宫大戏，没想到被马超几句话的功夫给绕过去了，江彩霞心里是又嫉妒又抓狂。

    “是啊，就算一家挖10斤回来那也是5毛钱，光咱们这里就有上百人，他有这么多钱吗？”

    这话一出，众人又开始议论了起来。

    “看看这是什么？”

    马超懒得废话，从兜里掏出56元，这钱本来是还给大姑一家，后来因为服装的事，被大姑父当成订金又给了马超。

    要没这56元，今天这事恐怕还不好收场。

    周围寂静无声。

    看着厚厚一叠钞票，周围人眼睛通红，剩下的全是吞咽声。

    “真，真的有钱……”

    “这小子真发了。”

    马超环顾四周询问，“够不够？”

    “够够够，绝对够了。”

    “马侄子，看你这，叔这就喊人去山里挖野菜，连夜给你送过来。”

    “等等！”
content_en:
"Are you telling the truth?"

    "Don't listen to his nonsense. It's 5 cents a pound. Ma boy, do you have that much money? Don't let everyone bring wild vegetables and you have no money to pay the bill."

    The person who said this was none other than Jiang Caixia.

    She had originally planned a forced-conception drama, but she didn't expect it to be bypassed by Ma Chao's few words. Jiang Caixia felt jealous and crazy.

    "Yeah, even if a family digs out 10 kilograms, it's only 50 cents. We have hundreds of people here alone. Does he have so much money?"

    As soon as these words came out, everyone started talking again.

    "Look what this is?"

    Ma Chao was too lazy to talk nonsense and took out 56 yuan from his pocket. This money was originally returned to his aunt's family, but later because of the clothing issue, his eldest uncle treated it as a deposit and gave it to Ma Chao.

    Without the 56 yuan, this matter might not have ended well today.

    There was silence.

    Looking at the thick stack of banknotes, the eyes of the people around him were red, and the rest were all swallowing sounds.

    "Really, really rich..."

    "This kid is really mad."

    Ma Chao looked around and asked, "Is it enough?"

    "Enough, enough, absolutely enough."

    "Nephew Ma, look at you. I'm going to ask people to dig wild vegetables in the mountains and deliver them to you overnight."

    "Wait!"
